C0931.title: Debt Evasion Intermediaries Resurface Under Interest Rate Cap Policy, Urging Borrowers to Refuse Repayment
C0931.summary: In August 2021, as regulators in multiple regions issued window guidance to cap personal consumption loan interest rates at 24% APR, debt evasion intermediaries (anti-collection alliances) became active again. They set up financial literacy education institutions or rights protection studios, using the pretext that loan contract rates exceed the window guidance to urge borrowers to refuse repaymen
